verdict.rationale: Zero's first-party MCP surface lists bulk archive and bulk delete, which shows the product can act on many emails at once. However, that surface is driven through a session-cookie-authenticated agent interface, not shown as selecting conversations in the inbox UI. Label modification is listed only as a general capability, not a bulk one, and nothing maps to 'mark done'. missing for 10: evidence of multi-select of conversations in the inbox UI, bulk labeling, a bulk mark-done action, a single-stroke or keyboard bulk action, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke

citations.quote: Bulk delete emails - Bulk archive emails
